en: Added You should know, a built-in mod where a side agent watches your back and flags things you or Claude might miss. Turn it on with `/plugin enable cc-plugin-you-should-know@builtin` (for first-party sessions with telemetry on)
zh: 新增 You should know，这是一个内置 mod，由侧边 agent 替你盯着，标记出你或 Claude 可能遗漏的内容。用 `/plugin enable cc-plugin-you-should-know@builtin` 开启（适用于开启遥测的第一方 session）
